name: INT. ENERGY INS.
source: CRON 20261014: International Energy Insurance Plc Financial Highlights for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), thousands of naira scaled to naira. Insurance revenue less insurance service expenses net of the net expenses on reinsurance contracts equals the printed insurance service result exactly; that result plus investment return less operating and other expenses equals the printed profit before taxation, and less the printed income tax expense equals the printed profit for the period. The investment return line has no row in the panel schema, so Operating Profit (EBIT) is set equal to the printed profit before taxation, the entity reporting no finance cost outside it. EPS in naira per share from the printed kobo figure. | NGX audited annual report (filed PDF, _ngx_pdf) FY2025

unitGuard.reason: Withheld: the EPS row reads -85 for FY2024, the OPPOSITE sign to the net profit reported for the same period (2.95436e+09), and its magnitude is 36.94x that period's net profit divided by the shares on file (2.30075) - a figure of a different order, not a share-count basis difference. The inputs on file do not recover the printed per-share figure, so nothing is published for this period. A blank is honest; a per-share figure whose sign contradicts its own period's earnings is not.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
